headline: Energy Dominance
dek: The President says New Yorkers pay three to seven times more for natural gas because of Democratic policies, and promises American Energy Dominance. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Despite the United States having the MOST ABUNDANT Supply, and LOWEST COST Natural Gas in the World, Citizens in Blue States like New York have been paying 3X-7X more for Natural Gas due to the costly Anti-Energy Policies pushed by Blue State Governors and Political leaders. We must protect our American Families from these Radical Climate Extremists, they are exploding Energy costs. The Democrat Party wants to ban all Pipelines, all Refineries, and all Fossil Fuels. The great news is that I am working to END the Left's War on Energy Affordability and Energy Security, and I will UNLEASH American Energy Dominance for ALL Americans! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: Citizens in Blue States like New York have been paying 3X-7X more for Natural Gas due to the costly Anti-Energy Policies pushed by Blue State Governors and Political leaders.
original.context: Posted on 16 November 2026. The prices, the comparison and the account of Democratic policies are the President’s. Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 17 November 2026 (shown as Nov 16, 2026, 4:44 PM Pacific).

meanwhile.hook: Trump promises Energy Dominance. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
steve: I just dominated my thermostat: sixty-four degrees and two sweaters.
*The only thing unleashed in this house is my gas bill.*

fact.text: U.S. households, 27% of all households, had trouble paying their energy bills or kept their home at an unsafe temperature because of the cost.
fact.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Residential Energy Consumption Survey 2020
